messages.subject: ISA Settlement Licence — Ref. ISP-2147-ACC-1776369963213-THIWIK1M-AUTH
messages.body:
To the registered CEO of Test Corp,

Your corporation has been assessed and approved under the provisions of the Interstellar Settlement Protocol (Earth Assembly Act, 2147).

This licence grants your corporation the legal right to:
  — Establish a registered operational presence at any ISA-recognised station
  — Apply for extraction rights across approved bodies within the Sol system
  — Engage in commerce on the Galactic Exchange under your registered charter

Your first recommended action is to secure office space at Earth Station Prime. Enclosed is your Founding Charter reference number for all future ISA correspondence.

Founding Charter Ref: ISP/ACC-1776369963213-THIWIK1M/FC-001

Liaison Officer Aria Voss
Interstellar Settlement Authority — Sol Division
